commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
90+4' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 6:7.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
86' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
85' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham).

85' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the top right corner, but Guglielmo Vicario pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Everton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
83' The whistle blows and Nathan Patterson (Everton) is booked for an infringement.
82' 2 - 1 Goal! Andre Gomes (Everton) has a reason to celebrate.
79' That will be all from Amadou Onana who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Beto (Everton).
75' Andre Gomes (Everton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

75' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. Tottenham get a corner.
73' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Pape Matar Sarr is replaced by Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham).
71' Neat passing move from Everton in order to create new attacking opportunities.
70' Everton fail to score from a corner as Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) leaps to collect the ball.
70' Nathan Patterson (Everton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' Sean Dyche has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) replacing Jack Harrison.
63' Substitution. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Richarlison walks off.

62' James Garner (Everton) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the left post. Good effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
62' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Everton.
56' Great teamplay by Tottenham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
53' The goal by Everton is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
52' Wait! Referee Stuart Attwell has indicated he is going to review the Everton goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
51' Goal - 2:0! Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Andre Gomes provided an assist for the goal.
49' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Half-time substitution. Ange Postecoglou decided to make a change. Cristian Gabriel Romero is replaced by Eric Dier (Tottenham).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Dwight McNeil (Everton) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
45+2' Jack Harrison (Everton) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Guglielmo Vicario has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
40' A pass by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
37' The ball goes out of play and Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
37' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
35' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
35' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
33' The Tottenham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
31' The current number of shots on goal is 4:2.
28' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
26' Amadou Onana (Everton) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
25' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
24' Sean Dyche is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Idrissa Gueye (Everton) suffers an injury and Andre Gomes comes on.
23' The referee shows the yellow card to Idrissa Gueye (Everton).
22' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

18' 2 - 0 After a goalmouth scramble Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) wins the ball and unleashes a powerful and precise effort into the back of the net, beating the helpless goalkeeper. A wonderful football moment.
18' The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
17' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
17' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is first to react to a lofted pass and sends a fine header towards the left side of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario denies him with a good save.

13' Emerson Royal sends a good ball to the edge of the box and Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) gets in a shot which goes narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
9' 1 - 0 Richarlison (Tottenham) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
8' Everton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
8' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes.
4' Everton will take a corner kick.
1' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Jordan Pickford makes a comfortable save.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Stuart Attwell.
